listing.name: Men in Black: The Game / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Play Men in Black: The Game with a native player built from your matching original disc.

steps.title: Supply the exact original disc
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe Men in Black: The Game disc, SLES-01047, with its single data track intact.

steps.title: Prepare the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: Select the complete matching disc as a CHD in Portcove. Portcove prepares and builds the player locally using the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. On Linux, put your native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. Choose Play after preparation.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac or a separate upstream-owned copy
steps.instruction: On Mac, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP for your system and put the Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. Run the upstream Men_in_Black__The_Game_Recompiled setup host and complete Generate & rebuild with your own matching original. Keep all tracks together for a CUE image. Add build-release/Men_in_Black__The_Game_Recompiled as the player, with build-release as the start folder. Use the kit’s supported BIOS instructions for an upstream-owned copy.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
The source check uses first data-track identity and track count. Keep the full original disc intact. Mac setup, native gameplay and populated-save compatibility remain unobserved.

references.title: Keep the data and runtime you actually use
references.instruction: For Portcove-managed copies, compatible replacement preserves declared saves, settings, mods and overlay captures. Keep the original disc separately. For an upstream-owned copy, retain the complete creating folder and back up your saves and settings before replacement.
